jobgether-jobgether:lever:1510b02e-7352-.title: Mortgage Loan Originator - Outside
jobgether-jobgether:lever:1510b02e-7352-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mortgage Loan Originator - Outside based in Brazil. This is a part-time, commission-based opportunity focused on originating residential mortgage loans and supporting loan production. The role combines consultative sales, borrower guidance, financial document review, and close coordination with processing and underwriting teams. You will work directly with prospective borrowers to understand their needs and identify suitable mortgage solutions. Success in this position requires strong relationship-building skills, organization, follow-through, and attention to lending requirements. The role is designed for someone comfortable working independently and spending significant time conducting sales activities outside the employer’s place of business. You will contribute to a smooth customer journey from initial application through processing and closing while maintaining compliance and quality standards. This opportunity is particularly suited to professionals with mortgage or financial services experience and an active NMLS license. Originate residential mortgage loans in accordance with applicable lending regulations, policies, and internal guidelines. Conduct borrower interviews to collect financial information, understand individual circumstances, and assess potential eligibility. Review applicant financial documentation and help determine appropriate loan programs based on borrower needs and qualifications. Educate prospective and existing clients on available mortgage products, terms, requirements, and procedures. Prepare and submit complete loan applications to processing and underwriting teams for review and approval. Maintain accurate and up-to-date borrower and loan information within the applicable loan origination system. Follow up consistently with borrowers, processors, underwriters, and other stakeholders to keep applications progressing efficiently. Collaborate with internal teams to facilitate smooth and timely loan closings. Meet established productivity, sales, quality, and service objectives. Stay current on lending policies, regulatory and compliance requirements, mortgage market developments, and industry practices. Conduct sales activities independently and predominantly away from the employer’s place of business, in accordance with applicable outside-sales requirements. Requirements High school diploma or equivalent; college coursework or a degree is preferred. Valid NMLS license as required by applicable state and federal regulations. Previous professional experience in mortgage lending, banking, financial services, or a related field is preferred. Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, negotiation, and verbal and written communication skills. Ability to understand borrower needs and explain financial products and processes clearly. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple applications, priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, sales-oriented environment. Familiarity with mortgage loan origination systems and Microsoft Office tools. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, and quality. Self-motivated and comfortable working in an outside-sales environment with performance-driven objectives. Benefits Part-time employment opportunity. Commission-only compensation structure. Opportunity to earn overrides on qualified loans originated by other Mortgage Loan Originators, where applicable. Remote work arrangement. Opportunity to build and manage client relationships within the residential mortgage market. Direct exposure to mortgage origination, lending processes, underwriting, and loan closing activities. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3d4f9eb9-3232-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Product Management - App Marketplace (Partnerships) based in India. This is a senior commercial and ecosystem leadership role responsible for scaling a high-impact B2B SaaS app marketplace. You will define which technology partners enter the ecosystem, build strategic relationships, and turn those partnerships into meaningful commercial growth. The role combines partner acquisition, commercial negotiation, marketplace strategy, and revenue ownership. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams to create a thriving partner ecosystem. Your work will directly influence marketplace GMV, revenue, customer value, and platform expansion. This is an opportunity to build and shape a rapidly growing ecosystem within a global, remote-first environment. Build and own a high-quality pipeline of potential marketplace partners, ranging from major software platforms to specialized vertical-focused applications. Own the complete partnership lifecycle, from prospecting and initial conversations through business cases, commercial negotiations, technical scoping, launch, and post-launch growth. Negotiate commercial agreements covering revenue sharing, payouts, exclusivity, support obligations, referrals, and other marketplace economics in collaboration with Legal and Finance. Serve as the senior relationship owner for strategic partners, developing long-term executive relationships beyond individual launches. Define the marketplace ecosystem strategy by identifying priority categories, assessing market coverage, and determining where additional partner capabilities are required. Conduct ongoing marketplace gap analysis using installation data, search behavior, support trends, agency feedback, and other customer insights to identify unmet needs. Convert ecosystem gaps into actionable partner targets, recruitment strategies, and signed partnerships. Own marketplace GMV and revenue targets, including forecasting, performance reporting, and communication of results to leadership. Identify and develop additional revenue opportunities, including revenue-share models, paid placement, bundles, and two-way referral opportunities. Monitor ecosystem health through metrics such as installations, active usage, partner retention, revenue per partner, and marketplace-driven revenue retention. Collaborate with Finance on partner billing, multi-currency payouts, taxation, and other operational requirements across international markets. Partner with GTM and Marketing teams to create effective launch strategies, including in-app promotion, announcements, agency communications, webinars, and co-marketing. Develop repeatable marketplace launch processes and playbooks that improve speed, consistency, and partner performance over time. Activate partners as a reverse acquisition channel by leveraging their audiences to generate awareness and growth. Work with Sales and Customer Success to position the marketplace as a driver of customer retention, expansion, and overall platform value. Bring partner feedback and market intelligence into product and engineering priorities, advocating for API, billing, or infrastructure improvements required to unlock ecosystem growth. Represent the platform with developers, technology partners, and executive stakeholders through industry events, community engagement, and strategic conversations. Mentor existing team members and contribute to building a partner-management organization as the marketplace scales. Requirements: 12+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, alliances, ecosystem development, or similar commercial roles within the software industry, with progressively increasing scope and responsibility. At least 4 years of direct experience working with an app marketplace, developer ecosystem, platform

jobgether-jobgether:lever:fb612da2-7938-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, ML Ops based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to build the infrastructure that powers machine learning and autonomy systems in a real-world robotics environment. You’ll own critical data pipelines that transform fleet sensor data into reliable, versioned datasets for perception and ML teams. Your work will improve experimentation speed, model development, dataset quality, and operational reliability. You’ll also design training workflows and tooling while helping optimise cloud infrastructure and costs. The position combines software engineering, MLOps, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and robotics technologies. You’ll work closely with technical teams to create reproducible workflows and accelerate the path from field data to production-ready models. This is a high-impact opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges in a fast-moving autonomous systems environment. Build and maintain robust data pipelines that ingest field data, including rosbags, sensor logs, and fleet telemetry. Transform raw field data into curated, versioned datasets that can be reliably accessed and used by perception and machine learning teams. Own dataset management processes, including storage, indexing, querying, versioning, and dataset delivery. Develop and maintain training workflows while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and optimise cloud infrastructure costs. Build internal tooling that accelerates perception engineering workflows, including fast data access, reproducible experiments, and automated evaluation pipelines. Develop metrics, monitoring, and diagnostics to assess dataset health, model performance, and overall pipeline reliability. Collaborate closely with perception, ML, robotics, and engineering teams to understand infrastructure requirements and improve development workflows. Apply sound software engineering and DevOps practices to create reliable, maintainable, and scalable MLOps infrastructure. Contribute to the continuous improvement of data and model development processes in a robotics and autonomous systems environment. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Strong Python programming skills and working knowledge of ROS2. Practical knowledge of Docker and other DevOps or containerisation tools. Familiarity with cloud storage and compute services, particularly AWS technologies such as S3 and EC2. Solid understanding of machine learning workflows, data pipelines, and dataset versioning. Experience designing or maintaining reliable data infrastructure and automated workflows. Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to reliability, reproducibility, and data quality. Ability to collaborate effectively with ML, perception, robotics, and software engineering teams. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field is preferred. 2+ years of MLOps or data infrastructure experience, preferably within robotics, autonomous systems, or another data-intensive technical environment. Experience with Weights & Biases, rosbag data, or large-scale sensor datasets is an asset. Working knowledge of C/C++ is preferred. Experience supporting perception or machine learning research teams is a plus. Willingness to work onsite in Toronto . Benefits: Base salary: CA$123,828–CA$154,785 for the Toronto position. Equity: Opportunity to participate in company equity. High-impact technical work: Build infrastructure supporting autonomous systems and real-world robotics applications. Cross-functional environment: Work closely with ML, perception, robotics, and engineering specialists. Opportunity for growth: Develop expertise across MLOps, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and autonomous systems. Innovation-focused environment: Cont

southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:0597dd8.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. Leads are arriving faster than we can route them, and the systems that should catch them are still being built. This role is for someone who sees a messy funnel and wants to fix the plumbing. You'll own the operational layer underneath our go-to-market motion: how leads get captured, scored, routed, and measured. It's not glamorous work, but done well it's the difference between a pipeline that compounds and one that leaks. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own inbound lead flow: capture, deduplicate, enrich, and route leads so nothing falls through - Build and maintain lead scoring and segmentation rules, then refine them as we learn what converts - Keep our CRM and GTM tooling clean and trustworthy, since every downstream decision depends on it - Build the funnel reporting the team actually reads: weekly conversion, stage drop-off, and channel efficiency - Automate repetitive GTM work using no-code tools and light scripting - Instrument outbound sequences and campaigns so results can be measured and compared - Turn one-off manual tasks into reusable systems that keep working after you've moved on YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF - You're pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience - You've worked with CRM, automation, or analytics tooling, whether HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Airtable, or similar - You're comfortable with spreadsheets at a serious level, and you know some SQL or Python or want to learn - You think in systems: you'd rather build the process once than do the task ten times - You're data-informed and understand the basics of funnels and attribution - You're detail-oriented, because bad data quietly breaks everything downstream Bonus: experience building dashboards, or prior ops work at a startup
